payload.toolName: Upload Limit Fixer by PrintableTools Lab
payload.description: Free no-signup upload error matcher for PDF, image, photo, and file-size limits. It maps common rejected-upload messages to the right browser-based PDF/image tool, including PDF under 1MB or 500KB, image under KB/MB targets, wrong file type, PDF-to-JPG, photo dimensions, screenshots, resume PDFs, and email attachment limits. Optional manual fix-plan requests are separate; the free tool works without registration.
payload.keyFeatures: No signup. No file upload to a server. Browser-based upload error matching. PDF and image size target suggestions. Public-safe notes only. Free tool works before any optional service request.
payload.additionalNotes: Specific free tool page submission. The broad PrintableTools Lab homepage was submitted earlier; this entry is for the free Upload Limit Fixer workflow and is not a paid-only product. It does not ask for private files, portal logins, payment details, tax details, or account data.
